original_test_intent: Validate the intended application-level PCIe Gen5/NVIDIA workload and its performance plus power/thermal behavior, preserving that the source names RIN Power/thermal while historical automation names pcie_gen5_app_perf.
original_method: Obtain an authoritative branch or separate variants; pin NVDiag/RIN build, test ID/config and stable GPU/link topology; define workload/data/duration/metrics/units/thresholds and whether any exception applies; preserve baseline and drain jobs; run one approved target-complete workload under telemetry/watchdog; compare performance and thermal/power/error results and verify cleanup/usability.
manual_activity: NVIDIA performance/platform owner selects RIN Power/thermal, app_perf or separate variants and approves target/config/duration/oracles/safety and owns verdict.
required_inputs: Decision on authoritative RIN test ID versus app_perf coverage
Signed pinned NVDiag/RIN artifact and immutable config
Stable GPU UUID/BDF/link/device-selector map and target utilization oracle
Dedicated window, job drain, telemetry, watchdog, OOB and recovery
safety_requirements: Do not run or merge branches before workload identity decision
No floating latest or generic stress substitution
Abort on limit, XID/reset, link, process or management anomaly
Stop all children, preserve first failure and never clear or auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Await branch/oracle decision and validate artifact/target/safety gates
Capture baseline and run one approved workload
Cleanup/recover and report without DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve RIN Power/thermal versus app_perf and variant relationship
Approve workload, metrics, thresholds, duration and exceptions

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It invents app_perf and a SKU exception while the Master literal names RIN Power/thermal.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No module before decision. Run only the pinned vendor test ID/config selected by engineering on the confirmed GPU/topology, retaining complete unfiltered output and metrics.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Master RIN Power/thermal wording, app_perf historical branch and ten/twenty-minute metadata remain; no branch or duration is inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Publish branch-specific immutable configuration and a per-GPU performance/utilization/power/thermal/throttle/error table tied to full vendor output and post-usability evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Prevents a generic pass from concealing which workload ran and how application performance was judged.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Transport bandwidth or RIN thermal load cannot substitute for application performance unless the owner explicitly defines the relationship.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Different NVDiag releases may rename test IDs; only vendor manifest mapping can establish equivalence, not string similarity.

project_override_considerations: Performance owner may split RIN Power/thermal and app_perf into separately governed checkpoints; original row remains intact and no coverage is merged here.
expected_evidence: Approved operation decision and NVDiag/RIN build/test-ID/config hashes
Stable GPU/link topology and pre-run health/utilization/error baseline
Per-GPU performance units/statistics/thresholds plus power/thermal/clocks/throttle/utilization trace
XID/AER/dmesg/BMC deltas, abort/cleanup and post-usability evidence

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master Procedure names RIN `Power, thermal`, while DeepSeek/history names `pcie_gen5_app_perf`; historical SKU exception is also absent from Master Criteria, so operation and acceptance differ.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Conflict is queued for engineering decision; static review is complete and later cases continue.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row256 Wistron-NV GPU-00249-V002: decide whether authoritative coverage is NVDiag RIN `Power, thermal`, `pcie_gen5_app_perf`, or separate variants; approve exact build/test ID/config, GPU/topology, workload/data/duration, performance/power/thermal metrics and thresholds, and whether any SkuCheck exception is actually authorized.

review_improvement: Keeps the conflicting workload identities and acceptance policies visible and requires quantitative application-level evidence before any verdict.
independent_technical_reasoning: RIN Power/thermal and a PCIe application-performance module can share stress side effects yet measure different requirements. A successful run from one cannot establish the other's coverage. Application results also need workload/data and target-complete utilization; otherwise the tool may pass while exercising only part of the system. The SKU exception cannot be inherited from adjacent cases because it changes acceptance and is absent from this Master criterion.
